{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness QoL plugin for the local Qwen3.8 line (27B/Flash-Next): per-request thinking budgets, a compaction backend that stops burning the output cap on thinking, and a settings tab. 本地 Qwen3.8 线的 DSH QoL 插件：逐请求 thinking 预算、不再把输出帽烧在 thinking 上的压缩后端、设置 tab。","id":"gh:1353073838","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-qwen38-local-qol","slug":"Yunado/dsh-qwen38-local-qol","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","llama-cpp","local-llm","qwen"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness QoL plugin for the local Qwen3.8 line (27B/Flash-Next): per-request thinking budget"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"s, a compaction backend that stops burning the output cap on thinking, and a settings tab. 本地 Qwen3."},{"id":"p1s3","text":"8 线的 DSH QoL 插件：逐请求 thinking 预算、不再把输出帽烧在 thinking 上的压缩后端、设置 tab。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-qwen38-local-qol"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/Yunado/dsh-qwen38-local-qol/) · [](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugin"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s/yunado/dsh-qwen38-local-qol) · [](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/Yunado/dsh-qwen38-local-qol?ref=b"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"adge) · [](https://github.com/Yunado/dsh-qwen38-local-qol/blob/main/LICENSE)"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[](https://www.dsh.so/artifact/dsh-qwen38-local-qol/) · [](https://www.dsh.so/artifact/dsh-qwen38-lo"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"cal-qol/) · [](https://www.dsh.so/artifact/dsh-qwen38-local-qol/) · [](https://www.dsh.so/artifact/d"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"sh-qwen38-local-qol/)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"A QoL plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) for running **Qwen3.8 locally**, with no core patches and no"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) for running **Qwen3.8 locally**, with no core patches and no pi-ai patchfile."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Model support**: Qwen3.8-27B · Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
- **Serving engines**: llama.cpp `llama-server"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"` · NInfer · TabbyAPI (ExLlamaV3) · oMLX (Apple Silicon MLX)
- **Note**: the llama.cpp lane is the s"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"tandard OpenAI-compatible `/v1` API - any server speaking it is expected to work there (Strata, Unsl"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"oth Desktop, LM Studio)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## DSH compatibility"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| DSH host | Plugin | Status |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| 0.2.2-alpha.2 and newer (production runs 0.2.2-alpha.2) | `#v0.3.8` | tested (production, first on"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" `#v0.3.4`); v0.3.3 and older presets fail to mount there: upstream merged `list_agents` into the co"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ntrol plugin and dropped the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents` export the qwen38 "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"roster row referenced
| 0.2.1-alpha.1 - 0.2.2-alpha.1 (production ran 0.2.1-rc.2) | `#v0.3.3` | test"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ed (production, 0.2.1-alpha.1 and 0.2.1-rc.2); older plugin tags fail every turn there, the host rem"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"oved the built-in `{{cwd}}` prompt variable |
| 0.2.0-rc.2 | `#v0.3.2` or `#v0.3.3` | tested (produc"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"tion); v0.3.3 only removes content on top, no new host requirements |
| 0.1.7-alpha.1 - 0.2.0-rc.1 |"},{"id":"p10s8","text":" `#v0.3.3` | should work - same seam batch, not exercised |
| 0.1.6-alpha.2 and older | `#v0.2.0` | "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"uld work - same seam batch, not exercised |
| 0.1.6-alpha.2 and older | `#v0.2.0` | supported line |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`main` targets the 0.2.2-era preset roster; stay on `#v0.2.0` with older hosts."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Upgrading from v0.2.0 (host first, then plugin):"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it supports"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- **Per-request thinking budgets.** The llama.cpp line sends the selected per-effort budget on every"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" request (`reasoning_effort` + `reasoning_budget_tokens`, overrides the server's `--reasoning-budget"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"`); the NInfer engine reads its single thinking budget from the server startup flag (`--default-thin"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"king-budget`); the settings tab shows that as a note on the NInfer line (no input), while `defaultTh"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"inkingBudget` stays valid as a headless/env config field; the TabbyAPI line accepts both natively; t"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"he oMLX line (Apple Silicon MLX) accepts native top-level `thinking_budget` and `chat_template_kwarg"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"s.enable_thinking`, so per-effort budgets ride every request.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What can be tuned"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The settings tab is the primary entry; headless profiles and patch/env accept the same fields (an id"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"-scoped patch replaces the whole config; env covers what the patch does not set):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Area | Fields (env vars) | Defaults |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- **Vision token pricing on TabbyAPI / oMLX is not pinned**: token meters report image capacity as u"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"nknown on these lines until the backend image-processor formulas are calibrated (the request itself "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"works; only the pre-flight capacity projection is affected).
- **Multimodal tool messages are a newe"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"r wire form**: tool messages carrying resolved images are sent as a content array with `image_url` e"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ntries; each line's server must accept that form. A rejecting line answers with an HTTP error whose "},{"id":"p21s6","text":"body the adapter surfaces verbatim (never a silent drop).
- **Vision budget rejections self-heal**: "},{"id":"p21s7","text":"an NInfer 400 `media_budget_exceeded` ("vision raw patches exceed processor budget") classifies as `"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, so the harness's overflow recovery compacts history below the normal thres"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"hold and retries the step; only repeated budget failures (e.g. one image alone over the per-image ca"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"p) surface as an error.
- **The preset seam is a web-surface feature**: headless profiles do not mou"},{"id":"p21s11","text":"nt `agent-presets` rows; the provider route (thinking budgets) works on both surfaces.
- **Summarize"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"r internals depend on the engine version**: the wire rules (thinking off, full output cap) hold for "},{"id":"p21s13","text":"every engine version; engine internals are outside the plugin's control."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## DSH 兼容性"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| DSH 宿主 | 插件版本 | 状态 |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| 0.2.2-alpha.2 起（生产实跑 0.2.2-alpha.2） | `#v0.3.8` | 实测通过（生产，先跑 `#v0.3.4`）；v0.3.3 及更老的 preset 在该宿主上挂载"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"失败：上游把 `list_agents` 并入 control 主插件并删除了 qwen38 名册引用的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-ag"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ents` 导出
| 0.2.1-alpha.1 - 0.2.2-alpha.1（生产曾实跑 0.2.1-rc.2） | `#v0.3.3` | 实测通过（生产，0.2.1-alpha.1 与 0.2"},{"id":"p24s4","text":".1-rc.2）；更老的插件 tag 在该宿主上每轮必炸（上游移除了内置 `{{cwd}}` 提示词变量） |
| 0.2.0-rc.2 | `#v0.3.2` 或 `#v0.3.3` | 实测通过（"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"生产）；v0.3.3 在其上只做减法，不要求宿主新功能 |
| 0.1.7-alpha.1 - 0.2.0-rc.1 | `#v0.3.3` | 应可用 - 同一批缝，未实测 |
| 0.1.6-al"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"pha.2 及更早 | `#v0.2.0` | 支持线 |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`main` 已面向 0.2.2 宿主名册；老宿主请钉 `#v0.2.0`。"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"从 v0.2.0 升级（先升宿主，再升插件）："},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## 功能特性"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## 已知限制"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **TabbyAPI / oMLX 线的视觉 token 数未钉**：这些线上 token meter 报图片容量未知（请求本身正常，只影响预检容量投影）。
- **preset 接缝是 web "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"面功能**：headless profile 不挂 `agent-presets` 行；provider 路由（thinking 预算）两面都工作。
- **摘要器内部行为依赖引擎版本**：wire "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"层规则（thinking off、完整输出帽）对所有引擎版本生效；引擎内部行为不在本插件控制之内。"}],"truncated":true}
